titles: Shift Garlic & Herb Turkey and Bean Rice Bowl
method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Use unseasoned mince made from 100% skinless turkey breast, weighed raw. Commercial mixed-cut turkey mince is not the specified ingredient; ask the butcher for breast mince or mince skinless breast at home.

Start the 75g brown rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.

Deseed and dice the 90g red pepper and drain and rinse canned, ready-cooked kidney beans, then weigh out 90g; raw or dried kidney beans cannot be used in this method. Keep the 170g turkey breast mince chilled until the pan is ready. Do not rinse raw mince.
Mix 20g light mayonnaise, 1g garlic powder and 1g dried parsley in a small bowl. Keep this dressing cold until serving; it is not a cooking sauce and must not be simmered in the pan.

Heat half the listed olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the turkey breast mince, break it into small pieces with a spatula and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring until no raw clumps remain and it is steaming hot throughout. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must reach 70°C for 2 minutes. Keep cooking if it has not reached that endpoint; the suggested time is a guide. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Add the remaining half of the listed olive oil to the same pan. Add 90g red pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened with some bite. Keep the heat moderate so the small measured amount of oil does not smoke.
Add the drained kidney beans. Cover and heat for 3–4 minutes over a low heat, stirring halfway, until the beans are steaming hot.

Return the cooked turkey breast mince and its juices to the pan and stir through. Heat gently until the whole pan is steaming hot, stirring to distribute the heat. Spoon the pan mixture over the freshly cooked rice. Take the pan off the heat and spoon the cold dressing over each serving; do not return it to the hob. Serve immediately.
